name: Cup Noodles Spiced Chicken
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm Oil), Dehydrated Pieces 3.80% (Chicken, Carrot, French Beans, Cabbage & Curry Leaves), Iodised Salt, Hydrolysed Vegetable Protein Powder (Soya), Mixed Spices 1.49% (Red Chilli, Turmeric, Coriander, Black Pepper, Cumin, Fenugreek, Ginger, Clove, Nutmeg & Green Cardamom), Onion Powder, Sugar, Corn Starch, Maltodextrin, Yeast Extract Powder, Flavour Enhancers (INS 631, INS 627 & INS 620), Milk Solids, Acidity Regulators [INS 500(i), INS 451(i) & INS 330], Nature Identical Flavour, Edible Vegetable Oil (Coconut Oil), Thickener (INS 415) & Antioxidant (INS 319). ALLERGEN INFORMATION: CONTAINS WHEAT, SOY & MILK.
